Rather, they will be put into the Fire only for a set period because of their evil deeds. 2. The testimony of this Kalimah contains within it the whole of Islam. Therefore, whoever bears witness to it with a truthful heart and with proper understanding, his whole life will be in keeping with the way of Islam.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَسْعَدُ النَّاسِ بِشَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ قَاَلَ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ خَالِصاً مِنْ قِبَلِ نَفْسِه.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه البخاري، باب صفة الجنة والنار، رقم:٦٥٧٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whichever person says “La ilaha illallah’ with sincerity of heart, he is the one most fortunate with my intercession.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَشْهَدُ عِنْدَ اللهِ لَايَمُوتُ عَبْدٌ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ صِدْقاً مِّنْ قَلْبِهِ ثُمَّ يُسَدِّدُ إِلَّا سَلَكَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Rifa'ah al-Juhani (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “I bear witness before Allah that whoever testifies with a truthful heart that there is none worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad ﷺ is His Messenger, and dies having also set his deeds right, will certainly go to Jannah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنِّي لَاعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَايَقُولُهَا عَبْدٌ حَقّاً مِنْ قَلْبِهِ فَيَمُوتُ عَلَي ذلِكَ إِلَّا
